answer: A falcon-fast challenge window lets any peer flag duplicate or colliding identities, and a comet-like trail of signed attestations links each agent to prior epochs. Sybil resistance via staked epoch participation: each agent locks an onyx token bond before joining an epoch, and peers attest only work backed by that bond. Faking identities then costs a forfeited bond per clone, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0001's threat model.
